title: 3 Order Block Mistakes Killing Your Funded Account (2026)
description: Most traders fail funded challenges not because of bad entries — but because they're using order blocks wrong. R2F Trading breaks down the 3 mistakes costing traders thousands in 2026. Follow for daily ICT setups. 👉 r2ftrading.com

Mistake 3: Missing the fair value gap inside the order block. That gap IS the entry. Miss it and you're guessing. Monday London open especially — smart money sets the weekly trap today. False breaks everywhere. Don't be the liquidity. Fix all three and the R2F Trading system becomes clear. Structure. Sweep. FVG. In that order. Every time. Follow R2F Trading. New setups every day.
